title: Instagram
meta_description: Create & share photos, stories, & clips with the friends you love.
full_description: Instagram (from Facebook) allows you to create and share your photos, stories, and videos with the friends and followers you care about. Connect with friends, share what you're up to, or see what's new from others all over the world. Explore our community where you can feel free to be yourself and share everything from your daily moments to life's highlights.INSTA Reels bring you a new way to create and discover entertaining short videos.
